commitMessage: fix: EMPTY dtype propagation in DynamicCustomOp.calculateOutputShape
notes: testBroadcastEmpty PARTIALLY FIXED: shape dtype assertion now passes (boolean_and correctly returns BOOL+EMPTY shape). Execution error remains: Nd4j.empty(DataType.FLOAT) cached singleton has shapeInfo extras=0x2000 without EMPTY bit (0x8), so C++ BROADCAST_CHECK_EMPTY macro doesn't detect empty inputs. Root cause: CpuNDArrayFactory.empty() sets EMPTY bit but ConstantShapeHelper cache strips it. Previous failure was at line 1944 (dtype check), now at line 1956 (exec). Fixes applied: 1) Java DynamicCustomOp.calculateOutputShape EMPTY propagation now resolves correct dtype via DifferentialFunctionClassHolder, 2) C++ BroadcastableOp.cpp checks OP_TRAIT_LOGICAL for bool dtype.
